storage_classes.name: Object Storage

price.note: Included in the flat USD 5/month: 'Object Storage costs a flat rate of $5 a month, and includes 250 GB of storage.' The flat fee is charged regardless of usage (see plans).
'The default cost of storage per GB over the first 250 GB is $0.02.' The page adds that overages may vary by data center but lists no other storage rate.

capacity_gb.note: Included storage; usage above it is billed at the overage rate, so this is not a hard cap.

monthly_price.note: 'Object Storage costs a flat rate of $5 a month'; prorated for partial months.

put_per_1000.note: 'Currently, there are no charges for API requests for any Object Storage endpoint types.' Akamai says it is evaluating per-request charges for E3 endpoints, not appearing on invoices earlier than October 1, 2027.

get_per_1000.note: 'Currently, there are no charges for API requests for any Object Storage endpoint types.' Akamai says it is evaluating per-request charges for E3 endpoints, not appearing on invoices earlier than October 1, 2027.

list_per_1000.note: 'Currently, there are no charges for API requests for any Object Storage endpoint types.' Akamai says it is evaluating per-request charges for E3 endpoints, not appearing on invoices earlier than October 1, 2027.

price_per_gb.note: No retrieval fee is listed; absence of a line item.

typical_delay.note: Not stated in the sources checked.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Not stated on the pricing page or the pricing, limits and endpoint docs.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Not stated on the pricing page or the pricing, limits and endpoint docs.

notes: Subscription model: a flat USD 5/month includes 250 GB storage and adds 1 TB to the account's monthly network transfer pool; storage above 250 GB is USD 0.02/GB by default.
Jakarta (id-cgk) and São Paulo (br-gru) are left out of applies_to_regions: the page says overages may vary by data center and lists separate transfer prices for them.
Endpoint types E0-E3 differ in limits and performance (quotas and limits page); new projects should use E2/E3.

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: '1 TB of transfer allowance is added to your account's monthly global network transfer pool.' The page does not define TB; recorded as 1000 GB (decimal).

egress.free_allowance_scope: Added to the account-wide global network transfer pool shared with other Akamai Cloud services; prorated by active hours. No allowance is added to the Jakarta and São Paulo pools.

price.note: Egress overage is billed 'at the rate $0.005/GB for all data centers except for Jakarta ($0.015/GB)' and São Paulo ($0.007/GB).

notes: Jakarta: USD 0.015/GB overage; São Paulo: USD 0.007/GB overage (pricing page FAQ). The region selector on the same page shows USD 0.005/GB for Jakarta, which conflicts with the FAQ.
All outbound transfer from Object Storage is metered, even to services in the same data center; inbound is free (https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/network-transfer-usage-and-costs).

egress_fair_use.note: No fair-use rule for egress is stated on the pricing page or network transfer doc.

free_tier.note: No free tier for Object Storage. The pricing page shows a general Akamai Cloud promotion (USD 100 in credits), which is not modelled.

object_lock.note: Object Lock (GOVERNANCE and COMPLIANCE) is supported on all endpoint types E0-E3; must be enabled at bucket creation, enables versioning; managed only through the S3 API.

notes: AWS CLI v2.23.0+ and boto3 1.36.0+ default to data integrity checksums that Object Storage does not support; set request_checksum_calculation=WHEN_REQUIRED or use older versions (https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/aws-cli-sdks-support-details).
Multipart (partNumber) downloads are not supported; use byte-range requests.
Regions marked LA (limited availability) need a support ticket before use.
